00221 EnvCurveList EnvCurveList::blend(EnvCurveList const& other, float fraction) const throw()
00222 {
00223     const int maxSize = ugen::max(size(), other.size());
00224     const int minSize = ugen::min(size(), other.size());
00225     fraction = ugen::max(0.f, fraction);
00226     fraction = ugen::min(1.f, fraction);
00227     
00228     EnvCurveList newList(0.0, maxSize);
00229     
00230     for(int i = 0; i < minSize; i++)
00231     {
00232         EnvCurve& thisCurve = internal->data[i];
00233         EnvCurve& otherCurve = other.internal->data[i];
00234         
00235         if((thisCurve.getType() == EnvCurve::Numerical) && (otherCurve.getType() == EnvCurve::Numerical))
00236         {
00237             float thisValue = thisCurve.getCurve();
00238             float otherValue = otherCurve.getCurve();
00239             float newValue = thisValue * (1.f-fraction) + otherValue * fraction;
00240             newList.internal->data[i] = EnvCurve(newValue);
00241         }
00242         else
00243         {
00244             if(fraction < 0.5f)
00245                 newList.internal->data[i] = thisCurve;
00246             else
00247                 newList.internal->data[i] = otherCurve;
00248         }
00249     }
00250     
00251     // should really turn this loop "inside out" save doing the if() for each iteration
00252     for(int i = minSize; i < maxSize; i++)
00253     {
00254         EnvCurve& thisCurve = internal->data[i];
00255         EnvCurve& otherCurve = other.internal->data[i];
00256         
00257         if(size() < other.size())
00258         {
00259             if(fraction < 0.5f)
00260                 newList.internal->data[i] = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Linear);
00261             else
00262                 newList.internal->data[i] = otherCurve;
00263         }
00264         else
00265         {
00266             if(fraction < 0.5f)
00267                 newList.internal->data[i] = thisCurve;
00268             else
00269                 newList.internal->data[i] = EnvCurve(EnvCurve::Linear);
00270         }
00271     }
00272     
00273     return newList;
00274 }
